label: v9.0.0-base
$comment: Gate spec for the v9.0.0 promotion, RE-ANCHORED on golden v0.1.3 (2026-08-06). Construction is v7.0.0-base's, unchanged: floors are cut from the SHIPPED baseline's own readings under the ship config, with support-aware Wilson margins. What changed is the ANSWER KEY. v0.1.2 folded a US street into one span while the corpus (TIGER's decompose, the street-affix shard, the ComponentTag union) splits it, and per-locale-f1 glued the model's spans back together to compare. v0.1.3 moves the key onto the corpus convention and declares it; the scorer now reads that declaration per row. Under the folded key the v9.0.0 candidate read us.street 87.4 against a 87.8 floor and FAILED; under the corrected key the candidate reads 75.2 against the baseline's 71.7 and LEADS by 3.5pp. The sign of the delta flips with the convention, which is why answer-key versions are not comparable across conventions and why this spec exists rather than a floor edit to v7.0.0-base.

$baseline.locality_lexicon: v6 (what the package ships — the G8 DE-fold revert, carried from v7.0.0-base)
$baseline.$note: The gate ran against a package-shaped cache built from the published tarball, not the dev-linked workspace: on 2026-08-06 the shared repo's neural-weights-en-us was staged with the v9.0.0 CANDIDATE (model.onnx md5 cd31cfc346075d7c044d53499f79f141, card 9.0.0). Anyone re-cutting these floors must verify the md5 above before trusting a 'dev-linked is the shipped lineage' assumption.

$margin_rationale: floor = the 7.0.0 reading - max(1.0pp, 2 x the downward Wilson 95% half-width at the metric's own support), computed on the CONTINUOUS reading (no rounding to an integer success count — rounding reproduces us.street_suffix as 70.1 where v7.0.0-base says 69.9). The rule is verified against v7.0.0-base on every fixture this spec did not change: us.postcode 93.7, us.country_homograph_f1 64.8, us.street_prefix 57.0, us.street_suffix 69.9, us.unit_real 73.0, us.intersection_real 80.7 and fr.postcode 98.8 all re-derive byte-identically.
$ratchet_policy: Floors ratchet: on an instrument v7.0.0-base also measured, this spec takes max(v7 floor, re-cut floor) so a re-score can only tighten. TWO floors are exempt because their instrument CHANGED and the numbers are therefore not comparable: us.street (folded phrase F1 -> unfolded street-name F1) and us.micro (whose tag set now carries street_prefix/street/street_suffix separately). Those two are re-anchored outright, and carrying the v7 numbers forward would have been the error this whole exercise exists to correct.

$derivation.us.postcode: 95.9 - 2.23pp (2 x 1.12pp Wilson at n=1523) = 93.7; ratchet vs v7 93.7 -> 93.7. per-locale-f1 us column.
$derivation.us.country_homograph_f1: 87.5 - 22.74pp (2 x 11.37pp Wilson at n=54, the fixture n v7.0.0-base used) = 64.8; ratchet vs v7 64.8 -> 64.8. score-country-homograph.
$derivation.us.micro: 85.7 - 2.76pp (2 x 1.38pp Wilson at n=2660) = 82.9. RE-ANCHORED, not ratcheted: the micro-F1 tag set changed with the unfold, so v7's 87.4 measures a different quantity.
$derivation.us.locality: 83.4 - 3.79pp (2 x 1.89pp Wilson at n=1616) = 79.6; ratchet vs v7 77.0 -> 79.6. per-locale-f1 us column, untouched by the relabel.
$derivation.us.region: 91.6 - 2.23pp (2 x 1.12pp Wilson at n=2660) = 89.4; ratchet vs v7 89.3 -> 89.4. per-locale-f1 us column.
$derivation.us.street: 71.7 - 4.03pp (2 x 2.02pp Wilson at n=1995) = 67.7. RE-ANCHORED, not ratcheted: v7's 87.8 was cut from a FOLDED reading of 90.5 and is not a bound on the unfolded street-name span. The absolute number drops ~19pp because the metric got strictly harder — it now requires the split to land in the right place, not merely the phrase to be right.
$derivation.us.street_prefix: 91.3 - 34.33pp (2 x 17.17pp Wilson at n=25) = 57.0; ratchet vs v7 57.0 -> 57.0. score-affix on street-affix-real, fixture unchanged.
$derivation.us.street_suffix: 96.6 - 26.74pp (2 x 13.37pp Wilson at n=30) = 69.9; ratchet vs v7 69.9 -> 69.9. score-affix on street-affix-real, fixture unchanged.
$derivation.us.unit_real: 97.0 - 24.01pp (2 x 12.00pp Wilson at n=34) = 73.0; ratchet vs v7 73.0 -> 73.0. score-affix on unit-real-designators.
$derivation.fr.postcode: 99.8 - 1.00pp (the 1.0pp floor; 2 x 0.43pp Wilson at n=1288 is smaller) = 98.8; ratchet vs v7 98.8 -> 98.8.
$derivation.us.po_box_real: 96.2 - 1.86pp (2 x 0.93pp Wilson at n=2000, the fixture n v7.0.0-base used) = 94.3; ratchet vs v7 88.2 -> 94.3.
$derivation.fr.cedex_real: 96.7 - 4.29pp (2 x 2.14pp Wilson at n=430) = 92.4; ratchet vs v7 84.2 -> 92.4. The v6-era named watch stays retired.
$derivation.us.intersection_real: 100.0 - 19.28pp (2 x 9.64pp Wilson at n=36) = 80.7; ratchet vs v7 80.7 -> 80.7. Graded as the weaker of the two spans.
$derivation.arena.perturb: 63.0 - 9.69pp (2 x 4.85pp Wilson at n=398) = 53.3; ratchet vs v7 59.9 -> 59.9 KEPT. The support also moved (v7.0.0-base recorded n=100; the perturbation arena now regenerates 398 cases), so the re-cut is looser than the standing bar and the ratchet holds the standing bar. Baseline reads 63.0, candidate 66.0 — both clear.
$derivation.de.native_locality: 91.5 - 2.00pp (legacy fallback; the leg does not expose its support) = 89.5; ratchet vs v7 89.1 -> 89.5. de-order-eval native-DE anchor-ON cell.
$derivation.fr.bare_street_intact: 75.0 KEPT VERBATIM from v7.0.0-base. A DESIGNED tolerance (#949), not a regression bar cut from a reading — designed tolerances never re-cut.

$watch.us.street_prefix_golden: The v0.1.3 key makes street_prefix scoreable in the per-locale us column for the first time: baseline 86.7, candidate 79.8 (-6.9pp). NOT a floor — the floored street_prefix instrument is score-affix, where both read 91.3 — but it is the one place the candidate trails the baseline on this key, and it wants a look before promote.
$watch.us.street_suffix_golden: Same column, the other direction: baseline 80.2, candidate 81.0.
$watch.us.unit_real: Baseline 97.0, candidate 93.9 (-3.1pp, n=34 so inside the margin). Carried as a watch, not a fail.
$watch.us.po_box_real: Baseline 96.2, candidate 97.0. The golden's own po_box column moves the other way (77.6 -> 75.0, n=21) — too small to floor, recorded so it is not rediscovered.
$watch.si-sentinel-ucakar: Still NOT a floor; the gauntlet keeps it gated. Carried forward from v7.0.0-base unchanged.
